FINDING, non-blocking, recorded not charged. `python3 scripts/lwb_check_proof.py --reexecute` on this head reports one digest MISMATCH: proof/39.json's recorded `python3 scripts/lwb_handoff.py --check` output no longer reproduces (recorded ab8f5e3..., re-run fb7daed...). The same command on origin/main reports ALL RE-EXECUTED COMMANDS MATCHED, so this PR introduces it. The cause is structural, not a defect in this change: lwb_handoff.py --check prints HANDOFF.md's byte count, this PR edits HANDOFF.md, and proof/39.json captured a digest of that output. Every future PR that touches HANDOFF.md -- which the handoff protocol requires of essentially all of them -- will do the same, so the mismatch count is on a path to grow monotonically. That step is `continue-on-error: true` in ci.yml and so cannot fail the job today, which is why this is not a blocker; but docs/maintainers/proof-of-completion-plan.md plans to make it blocking once digests are seen reproducing on a runner, and this class of mismatch would break that plan on its first PR. Worth a follow-up item (record output that excludes volatile byte counts, or exempt records whose captured subject file changed) rather than a change to this PR.
